description: Department of Local Government (Western Province) - Meeting in view of selecting a new Vice Chairman for the Vacated Vice Chairman's position of Kotikawatte Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha on 15.12.2021 at 9.30 a.m.
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting to select a new Vice Chairman for a local authority (Kotikawatte Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha). It is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically references electoral legislation amendments. The content deals with the electoral process for local government positions, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
